reading.body:
Texas's 2025 legislative session produced 126 tracked bills, with the heaviest AI focus on deepfake sexual content and health care algorithms, plus multiple data center tax exemptions tied to energy demand.

The largest cluster targets sexually explicit AI-generated media, especially material depicting children or computer-generated children, with repeated bills creating or increasing criminal penalties. A second cluster regulates AI in health care, including utilization review algorithms, insurance claim denials, and electronic health records. Data broker registration, biometric identifiers, and AI disclosure requirements also appear across multiple bills.

The data center provisions are the clearest link to compute and power. SB2888 proposes temporary sales tax exemptions for data center property, while HB5588, SB2222, and SJR72 would exempt data center real property and the tangible personal property used to meet energy demand from ad valorem taxation. That signals Texas treating data center energy infrastructure as a policy priority.

The data does not show which bills passed, only that they were filed between November 2024 and June 2025. The 126 count includes ceremonial resolutions and licensure compacts unrelated to AI, so the AI-specific total is lower.
